pages.title: Expand the decision boundary
pages.text:
Expand the decision boundary
Label one requires
∥z − c1∥2 < ∥z − c0∥2.
The ∥z∥2 terms cancel:
2z · (c1 − c0) > ∥c1∥2 − ∥c0∥2.
Equality is a line when the centers diﬀer.
Mathematical Cardiology Notes 15 / 19

pages.title: After inspecting an error
pages.text:
After inspecting an error
Changing the model in response to test errors makes those cases development data.
Retain the original result. Evaluate the changed rule on other observations.
A transparent ﬁt is useful because its assumptions and failures can be named.
Mathematical Cardiology Notes 19 / 19
